about: The Workbench icons of the Candy Crisis drawer: python3 AMICRADLE/scripts/port_icons.py amiga/icons/icons.json --out amiga/icons (DalsinAI/amicradle). The art is the game's own icon (packaging/candycrisis.png). CandyCrisis-drawer.info is the drawer's own icon, CandyCrisis.info beside the drawer; it has its own name here so as not to meet the program's CandyCrisis.info. CandyCrisisResources.info is the data drawer's.
